verdicts.evidence: The four cards under "Popular this week" show only $34, $89, $52 and $68, with no was-price, percent off or sale tag; the "Up to 40% off through Sunday" text is actually the subline, not the headline, but the defect is real.
The hero has a headline, a subline and a tilted blue rounded rectangle reading "SALE", and there is no other button or call to action in the banner.

The tilted, saturated blue "SALE" sticker on the right stands out against the beige banner and holds only the generic word, and the space between the headline and the sticker is empty beige; the sticker does not repeat "Up to 40% off", but that is a side detail.
All four card images are flat colour tiles with a pale rounded box in the centre, which look like placeholders.
